name: Air-Fryer Paneer Fingers
ingredients: 150 g low-fat paneer, cut in thick fingers
3 tbsp besan mixed with 3 tbsp water into a thick batter
½ tsp each chilli powder, garlic powder and ajwain
Salt, chaat masala and lemon wedges
steps: Season the paneer fingers with salt and spices.
Dip each in the besan batter and roll in breadcrumbs.
Preheat the air fryer to 190°C and spray the basket.
Cook in a single layer for 10–12 minutes, turning halfway, until golden.
Sprinkle with chaat masala and serve with mint chutney and lemon.
note: The besan batter keeps it egg-free; the air fryer uses far less oil than deep-frying.
